picks.headline: LG's Evo AI GM9 puts a 5K mini-LED creative display on the desk — at a price
picks.excerpt: The GM9 is a top-of-the-range monitor for creative work, media and gaming. And it costs a fair bit.
picks.rationale: The one item in the pool that lands directly on a designer's desk — a measured review of a 5K mini-LED panel aimed at colour-critical creative work.

picks.headline: XREAL's hands-on shows Android XR finally has hardware worth designing for
picks.excerpt: I've always been a bit skeptical of smart glasses and mixed reality headsets. It's not hard to find the utility...
picks.rationale: First real hands-on read of the platform XR interfaces will be built on — a skeptic's account of where Android XR's utility actually begins.

picks.headline: Xiaomi's AI Cube stacks three Xring chips to run a 120B model on your desk
picks.excerpt: Xiaomi has unveiled the AI Cube engineering prototype, a mini PC that combines its Xring O3, O100 and D100 chips for local AI model deployment. The system supports 120B and 3B models and can deliver up to 150 W performance.
picks.rationale: Local model inference moving into a 150 W desktop box — the hardware side of keeping client work and assets off the cloud.

picks.headline: Galaxy S26's seventh One UI 9 beta adds new AI features with the August patch
picks.excerpt: Samsung has rolled out its seventh One UI 9 beta for the Galaxy S26, delivering new AI features alongside the August 2026 security patches.
picks.rationale: The last beta shape of the OS a large slice of users will be on — worth reading now if your product ships an Android surface this autumn.

picks.headline: Viture and Phantom Blade Zero's studio turn XR glasses into a character object
picks.excerpt: Viture collabs with S-Game, the studio behind Phantom Blade Zero, for the Phantom Beast XR glasses with the sickest design I
picks.rationale: A rare case of XR eyewear styled as a game-world artifact rather than a black wayfarer — a live test of whether identity, not spec, sells wearables.
